svg.aria-label: How Vanguard works: consult the knowledge graph, rank advisories, narrow down, build the task, approve, validate, run the models, learn, and repeat
svg.title: How Vanguard works
svg.text: rank → build → validate → run → learn → repeat

g.text: 1 · Consult the graph. The agent consults the knowledge graph: which weaknesses defeat which model, under what conditions, on how much evidence.
2 · Rank advisories. Every real security advisory is scored with each model's chance of failing, plus the reasons and the evidence behind it.
3 · Narrow down. Unbuildable, duplicate and already-built candidates drop out. The strongest few get a complete build package.
4 · Build the task. An AI agent triages the fix and builds a Docker task: the vulnerable code, an impact-only report, hidden tests.
5 · You approve. A person reviews the built task. Nothing that costs money or can't be undone happens without approval.
6 · Validate. Fairness checks in Docker: the real fix scores 1.0 twice, no fix scores 0, a partial fix lands in between.
7 · Run the models. Model A and Model B attempt the task. A solve ends it at once; a double failure earns more attempts at gate 2.
8 · Learn. Results flow back into the graph: the forecast is scored, the predictor retrains, and the next ranking is sharper.
